name: bench
purpose: Search-cost optimization validation required by the maintainer before any formal full search (2026-10-19): CUDA bit-exactness and speed of DEPTH prefix reuse, the per-expansion overhead with save/reload validation on the device, and network-volume throughput and round-trip fidelity. Engineering only: nothing is selected, trained or evaluated.
_profile: the pilot's 1x base profile (75,660 tokens, 8,192-token items): real data at the formal 1x scale, already staged and hash-pinned by the pilot
_exactness: every 6th item (both short and 8k-token items, padded micro-batches) and THREE greedy rounds, so later rounds score candidates after non-trailing removals; the full 1x round in stage C is compared too

hardware.why: the formal searches' card: the timings are only useful on it
